sources.entry: DevToysMac - Offline toolbox that helps developers in daily tasks. ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: DevToysMac is a macOS port of DevToys for Windows, an offline toolbox of utilities for everyday developer tasks.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes DevToysMac as the Mac app version of DevToys for Windows. The screenshot headings name several tools: a JSON <> YAML converter, a number base converter, an HTML encoder/decoder, a URL encoder/decoder, a Base64 encoder/decoder, and a JSON formatter, with "and more" noted at the end. The awesome-mac listing describes it as an offline toolbox. The README gives no further detail on individual features or how each tool works.
use_cases: convert JSON to YAML and back
how_to_run: Manually: download the latest release and extract DevToys.app from DevToys.app.zip
Homebrew: install Homebrew, then run `brew install --cask devtoys`
notable: Mac port of the Windows DevToys developer toolbox
Works offline, per the awesome-mac listing
Installable via Homebrew cask or manual download
Covers common encoding, conversion, and formatting tasks in one app
caveats: The README does not document a license, system requirements, or the full list of tools
Mac-only; the README describes it as a Mac version of a Windows app
